statement: ∀ f : Module.End ℤ M, hat (K := K) (-f) = -hat (K := K) f
proof:
intro f
  have hz : hat (K := K) ((-1 : ℤ) • f) = ((-1 : ℤ) : K) • hat (K := K) f :=
    h_T009.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 (-1 : ℤ) f
  have hcast : ((-1 : ℤ) : K) = (-1 : K) := by norm_num
  have hn : (-1 : K) • hat (K := K) f = -hat (K := K) f := by
    rw [neg_one_smul]
  calc
    hat (K := K) (-f) = hat (K := K) ((-1 : ℤ) • f) := by rw [neg_one_smul]
    _ = ((-1 : ℤ) : K) • hat (K := K) f := hz
    _ = (-1 : K) • hat (K := K) f := by rw [hcast]
    _ = -hat (K := K) f := hn
